_comment: LandfallElementals 2026-10-18 (lfe-land cluster): Mossborn Hydra's enters-with counter
(enters_with_plus_counters) and landfall DOUBLING (landfall_double_self_counters), and the counters
PERSISTING across cleanup in the search's rollout and the executor alike. Forest, Forest, Mountain and an
uncracked Terramorphic Expanse; hand Mossborn Hydra + Forest; opponent at 4; resumed at main 1 of T4.
Library = dead Swords to Plowshares draws + ONE Forest (the crack's only target, reachable by search
but never drawn), so no land arrives after T4. Win T5 ONLY by casting the Hydra BEFORE both T4
landfalls (1 -> 2 on the drop -> 4 on the crack, or the crack held to T5's main 1): a 4/4 swings T5
for exactly 4. Land-first is 1 -> 2: 2 damage on T5, the win slips to T6. The Hydra is summoning sick
on T4, so the T5 win also proves the counters were not cleared at cleanup.
